fields.label: App Users
fields.description: Who can open the mobile app and log visits and cases

fields.label: Admins
fields.description: See every visit and case, and the whole team. Administrator is always an admin

fields.label: Can reset passwords
fields.description: Can set a new password for other users from the app

fields.label: Managers
fields.description: See the reps below them in the Sales Person tree and get their notifications

fields.label: Attendees
fields.description: Shown in the "Who attended?" list on a case

fields.label: See everything (read only)
fields.description: View only. Editing and deleting still follow Role Permissions

fields.label: See all Cases
fields.description: Planned, attended and cancelled cases of everyone

fields.label: Planned cases visible to all app users
fields.description: If off, a planned case is visible only to its creator and his managers, like attended cases
